description:
You are a receptionist at Morrison & Associates Law Firm. The managing partner has asked you to configure the visitor agreement in Lobby Track so that all visitors must acknowledge a confidentiality policy before being granted access to the building.

Perform the following steps in Lobby Track:

1. Navigate to the Settings, Configuration, or Administration area of Lobby Track (look for a Settings menu, gear icon, Options, or Administration panel — it may be in the menu bar or toolbar).

2. Find the Visitor Agreement (may also be called Visitor Policy, NDA, Terms, or Legal Agreement) settings section.

3. Enable the visitor agreement feature so it is required for all visitors during check-in. Look for a checkbox or toggle to enable/activate it.

4. Enter the following agreement text exactly:

By signing in, I acknowledge that I may be exposed to confidential information during my visit. I agree not to disclose, copy, or distribute any information obtained during my visit to Morrison & Associates. All visitors are subject to security screening upon exit.

5. Save the configuration changes (click Save, OK, or Apply).

6. After saving, take a screenshot confirming the agreement text is visible in the settings by running this command in a terminal:
   DISPLAY=:1 import -window root /home/ga/visitor_agreement_configured.png

The screenshot file MUST be saved at exactly: /home/ga/visitor_agreement_configured.png
